name: billflow
idea: BillFlow is a free, instant invoice generator for freelancers and small businesses — fill in your details, add line items, and export a professional PDF invoice in seconds, all inside the browser with zero sign-up.
why_trending: The freelance economy is accelerating in 2026: searches for 'free invoice generator' and 'invoice template PDF' consistently rank among the top commercial-intent queries in the tools category (competitors like Invoice Simple, FreshBooks Lite, and Wave all appear in top-10 ad positions). The post-pandemic remote-work wave and creator-economy boom have driven millions of new freelancers who need invoicing tools — validated by May 2026 micro-SaaS research showing solopreneurs as the #1 underserved segment for lightweight billing utilities.
why_profitable: Direct competitors monetize heavily: FreshBooks charges $17–55/month, Invoice Simple $9.99/month, Wave earns via payment processing fees (2.9% + $0.30 per transaction). A free tool captures high-intent traffic and monetizes via display ads ($5–12 CPM from a finance/business audience), a one-time 'Pro unlock' for custom templates and branding ($4.99), and affiliate commissions from accounting tools like QuickBooks and FreshBooks.
why_easy: 100% static HTML/CSS/JS — all invoice logic runs client-side. jsPDF (CDN) converts the live HTML preview to a pixel-perfect PDF with one function call. html2canvas handles PNG export. LocalStorage persists drafts between sessions. No database, no auth, no server — deployable to GitHub Pages, Netlify, or any static host instantly.
